173	    const sequences = conversation.entries.map(({ sequence }) => sequence)
174	        .filter((sequence): sequence is number => sequence !== undefined)
175	
176	    return sequences.length > 0 ? Math.max(...sequences) + 1 : undefined
177	}
178	
179	function appendAssistantMessage(
180	    conversation: AgentConversation,
181	    update: { content: string, messageId?: string, replace?: boolean, sequence?: number },
182	) {
183	    const sequence = update.sequence ?? nextConversationSequence(conversation)
184	    const latestUserIndex = conversation.entries.findLastIndex((entry) => entry.kind === 'message' && entry.role === 'user')
185	    const currentAssistantMessage = conversation.entries.slice(latestUserIndex + 1)
186	        .findLast((entry) => entry.kind === 'message' && entry.role === 'assistant')
187	    const messageId = update.messageId
188	        ?? currentAssistantMessage?.id
189	        ?? `${conversation.id}-assistant-${sequence ?? conversation.entries.length + 1}`
190	    const currentIndex = conversation.entries.findIndex((entry) => entry.kind === 'message' && entry.id === messageId)
191	    const entries: AgentConversationEntry[] = currentIndex < 0
192	        ? [...conversation.entries, {
193	            content: update.content,
194	            id: messageId,
195	            kind: 'message',
196	            role: 'assistant' as const,
197	            ...(sequence !== undefined ? { sequence } : {}),
198	            timestamp: conversation.startedAt,
199	        }]
200	        : conversation.entries.map((entry, index) => index === currentIndex
201	            ? { ...entry, content: update.replace ? update.content : `${entry.content}${update.content}` }
202	            : entry)
203	
204	    return { ...conversation, entries }

entries.content:
Done. Added 3 sections to `B_100`. No commit/stage.

**Cause found + proven from real transcript** (`card__05d5d49c…`, conv `agent-793ef4cc…`):

- Claude runs with `--include-partial-messages` → each assistant step hits wire **twice**: incremental partials, then aggregated `assistant` message.
- Adapter meant to fold aggregate onto streamed bubble via `providerItemId` key. Key lookup uses `this.activeBlocks`, keyed by block index, **cleared every `message_start`**.
- By time earlier step's aggregate lands, adapter advanced past it → `activeBlocks` miss → `handleAssistantCompletion` guard fires fresh `assistantStarted` → `startAssistantItem` makes SECOND `message` entry = duplicate bubble.
- Proof: duplicate copy has empty `\n\n` separator, only possible when `trackedBlock === undefined`.
- Last step not doubled: nothing clears its block before its aggregate arrives → key matches → replace-in-place.
- Codex single-item stream → no partial-vs-aggregate dup → unaffected.

Two fix directions given (stable per-step key, or suppress aggregate re-emit), plus regression-test spec for the partial→`message_start`→aggregate interleaving.

One caveat worth flagging: exact fix locus is `handleAssistantCompletion` in `agent_claude_streaming_adapter.js` — verify against live wire ordering before implementing, since I inferred ordering from stored entries, not raw stream capture.
